questions.text: A short quiz with one question of each kind, played right here in your browser. Answer on the phone; the big screen shows the questions and the results.
Which planet has the most known moons?
Which of these are mammals? Pick every correct answer.
questions.explanation: Dolphins and bats feed their young on milk; sharks are fish and penguins are birds.

questions.text: Honey found in ancient Egyptian tombs was still edible.
questions.explanation: Honey is too sugary and acidic for microbes, so it keeps for thousands of years.

questions.text: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.explanation: Canberra was built as a compromise between Sydney and Melbourne.

questions.text: How many keys does a standard piano have?
questions.explanation: 52 white keys and 36 black ones. The closer the guess, the more points.
Giza: about 2560 BC. Colosseum: AD 80. Eiffel Tower: 1889. Burj Khalifa: 2010.

questions.text: The Mona Lisa: who painted it, and in which city can you see it?
questions.explanation: Leonardo painted it in the early 1500s; it hangs in the Louvre. This question counts double.

questions.text: Match each animal with its young.
